_about: The FIXED, predetermined settings of every V2 AI-grading run. The runner refuses to start if a required flag is missing, and records this file's policy_version and the Claude Code version in every report. Change only deliberately, with a re-run of the injection test repos.

why.--restricted: student CLAUDE.md/hooks/settings are not loaded (exp. 1) and Read/Glob/Grep are confined to the repo, incl. symlinks and ../ (exp. 4)
why.--strict-mcp-config: no MCP servers from the student's .mcp.json or the account start (exp. 2)
why.tools: read-only; Grep lets the model check for absence; no shell, no writes, no web
why.model: an exact model ID, never an alias, so it can't change under us. Nov 18 (user): mid-level model by default to cut cost; V2 measurements before policy 2 were made with claude-opus-5-5.

operational: Run grading as a dedicated OS user whose home holds no secrets. Re-run the injection and experiment-4 test repos after every Claude Code upgrade.
